facts.business: National Aluminium Company Limited (NALCO) is an integrated aluminium producer engaged in mining bauxite, refining alumina, smelting aluminium, and generating power (including wind power) in India.

auditor.name: S R B & Associates and B M Chatrath & Co LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Corporate Governance non-compliance: (i) Board composition - less than 50% Non-Executive Directors for 134 days; (ii) Less than 50% Independent Directors throughout FY 2025-26; (iii) Audit Committee members lacking accounting/financial management expertise.

key_risks: Corporate Governance non-compliance with SEBI LODR regulations
Dependence on global aluminium and alumina prices
Regulatory and environmental compliance in mining operations
Project execution risk for major capacity expansions
facts.related_party_note: Joint Ventures: Angul Aluminium Park Pvt. Ltd. (49%), GACL NALCO Alkalies & Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. (40%), Utkarsha Aluminium Dhatu Nigam Limited (50%), Khanij Bidesh India Limited (40%).
